[[Vermin]] infest the rooftops of Kaineng City, posing significant threat to those who choose to travel above the city streets. According to [[Nicholas the Traveler]], they often come out when the moon is out. Though they can only be found in one place in-game, they're said to be very common in Kaineng City, and their hides are used in certain crafting by [[Bae Kwon]].
